about: A popular app that downloads files from Usenet automatically.

prs.title: The monthly download limit resets once, not twice
prs.broken: With a monthly limit set to reset on the 29th to 31st, short months reset it twice: on the last day and again on the 1st.
prs.changed: The reset day is now capped at the length of the month.
prs.matters: People who match the limit to their internet bill no longer get an extra month of data by mistake.
